text:
emma (finance): quick postmortem follow-up — capturing owners/tl; want a short ack + any timeline changes by EOD. original issue: delayed token ingestion + double-count spikes that impacted invoices for ~120 customers.

emma (finance): action slate I sketched (pls edit inline):
```
1) reconcile token delta + root cause analysis - owner: darren - ETA: 3/12
2) backfill delayed usage into ledger (idempotent) - owner: li - ETA: 3/14
3) invoice correction batch + credit memo pipeline - owner: marcus/brianna - ETA: 3/16
4) alert + runbook update for ingress lag thresholds - owner: sofia - ETA: 3/11
5) add regression test to CI for token dedupe case - owner: darren/li - ETA: 3/18
```

emma (finance): customers impacted list + current credit estimate in this sheet: https://redwood.internal/sheets/billing-postmortem-2415 (view only for now). pls confirm owners and tighten ETAs if necessary. :clipboard:

incident-bot: Incident PG-2024-03-09: delayed-token-ingest — postmortem published: https://redwood.internal/incidents/PG-2024-03-09

darren (eng-infra): ack. will take RC analysis + the CI test. think I can move RC ETA to 3/10 if I get time today to dig into consumer queue. changing to 3/10 provisional. :white_check_mark:

sofia (eng-sre): acked. I can push the alert/runbook updates by EOD 3/11 as quoted. will add a playbook step to failover to secondary ingestion path.

li (eng-ml): taking the backfill. want to confirm expected data volume — is the CSV dump ready from finance? I can parallelize the job to finish by 3/13 if we can run a priority batch window. ETA -> 3/13 (optimistic).

brianna (product): marcus and I will own the invoice corrections flow. need list of top-20 revenue customers first so we can prioritize manual reviews. marcus, can you confirm the list and approval cadence?

marcus (finance-lead): putting top-20 now in the sheet. also adding a quick tally of estimated credits. I'll partner with brianna on the correction batch. ETA 3/15 for approvals, 3/16 for batch run.

darren (eng-infra): quick note — for the RC, initial signal looks like a race in the batching consumer where reprocessing caused duplicate token writes. I will instrument a counter and surface metrics to the billing-prod dashboard.

sofia (eng-sre): adding an alert rule: "ingest_lag > 30m or retry_rate > 5%" and a runbook step to notify #eng-oncall + #finance on page.

emma (finance): thanks everyone. two asks: 1) add your Github issue numbers to the sheet in the actions column; 2) set a reminder here 24h before your ETA to confirm completion.

li (eng-ml): added GH #4217 to the sheet. setting reminder for 3/12 12:00.

darren (eng-infra): GH #4215 for RC + #4220 for CI test. reminder set.

brianna (product): GH #4222 for customer comms & correction process. scheduling a short sync with marcus at 10am tomorrow.

marcus (finance-lead): GH #4223 for invoice batch. I added the customer list and estimated credits to the sheet.

emma (finance): filing this as "postmortem follow-ups" in the tracker and linking GH/Sheets. I'll run a brief remediation review on 3/17 to confirm retro outcomes. everyone please ping me if ETAs slip.

sofia (eng-sre): noted. will also add a recurring weekly check for ingestion anomalies for 4 weeks to make sure the regression didn't reappear.

brianna (product): +1 on weekly checks. I'll draft the customer-facing message for affected customers and share for review by EOD tomorrow.

marcus (finance-lead): small ask — for the correction batch, can eng provide a dry-run CSV and a checksum to validate we won't double-credit? darren/li?

darren (eng-infra): yes, will produce a dry-run output and include a checksum column. li will validate idempotency during backfill.

li (eng-ml): will verify idempotency and sign off.

emma (finance): excellent. closing initial check-in — will repost reminder 24h before each ETA. thanks all. :pray:
